summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (Performance Baselines Completion) plans, clean up the code, populate journey timing baselines against staging, and get PR #355 merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 fully executed (3/3 plans, 9/9 verification must-haves), staging DB reset to fix vault init bug, journey baselines populated from real staging runs, code simplified, and three rounds of PR review comments resolved (19 threads total).

repo: Phase 22 consists of: SDK perf instrumentation (withPerf wrapper, 10+1 functions), Playwright E2E journey timing tests (3 user journeys), and load test thresholds with a 347-line capacity model.

Staging DB was never reset after Phase 20 removed encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key columns — the old NOT NULL constraints caused vault init 500 errors for new wallet logins.

Mock wallet injection uses page.addInitScript and EIP-6963 auto-announcement — works in Playwright test runner but not via MCP browser evaluate; the wallet is an EIP-1193 compliant wallet, not a mock adapter.
Journey timing baselines (staging): login-to-vault 23.6s (dominated by Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init), upload-to-visible 1.4s, share-to-accessible 3.0s.
Phases 21, 22, and 23 were all being worked on concurrently and out-of-order; the GSD phase complete tool can mislead about 'next phase' when phases are done non-sequentially.

GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow started requiring manual approval — suspected cause is git commit author email mismatch between local config and GitHub account, or a GitHub platform policy change.
The __CIPHERBOX_PERF__ opt-in flag exists as a deliberate escape hatch for enabling perf instrumentation in browser dev without PERF_ENABLED.
JOURNEY_TIMING: prefixed lines in baselines.md were not valid JSON — the prefix needed to be removed or the block reframed as a code block.

code.finding: Concurrent withPerf calls with the same operation name collide on mark names — fixed by adding a per-invocation counter suffix to mark/measure names.
PerformanceMeasure entries were not cleared after creation, causing unbounded accumulation in long sessions — fixed with performance.clearMeasures() immediately after measure creation.
PERF_ENABLED check used process.env directly — in browser builds with a process polyfill this could evaluate to true in production. Fixed with typeof process.env?.NODE_ENV === 'string' guard.
404 check was testing error.status directly but Axios puts the HTTP status on error.response.status — fixed to use AxiosError-compatible status check.
unpinFromIpfs was not instrumented with withPerf unlike addToIpfs and fetchFromIpfs — added for consistency.
5 load test scenarios each had identical 8-line threshold assertion boilerplate — extracted into expectThresholdsPassed() helper, removing the need for vitest expect import in scenario files.
account was declared as describe-level let but only used in one test — narrowed to const inside that test. PrivateKeyAccount import became unused after the change.
globalThis was cast as any to add perf property — replaced with declare global block for proper typing.

workflow: GSD phase commits that accidentally land on main can be rescued with: create feature branch at current HEAD, then git reset --hard origin/main, then switch to feature branch.
Playwright staging tests can be run with a temp config file overriding baseURL and disabling webServer — testDir must be an absolute path when config file is outside the repo.

The simplify skill runs three parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) and aggregates findings — some findings will be intentional design choices and should be explicitly noted as not applicable.
PR review comment resolution requires both a REST reply (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments with --field in_reply_to as integer) and a separate GraphQL mutation to mark the thread resolved.
Background task notifications for executor subagents can arrive late — if phase execution is already complete, stale task-notification messages can be safely ignored.
Staging DB reset procedure: ssh to server, docker compose stop api, drop and recreate database, docker compose start api — TypeORM synchronize recreates schema from current entity definitions.

friction: GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow started requiring manual approval mid-session with no clear cause — required manual intervention on the PR page.
Playwright temp config for staging required absolute testDir path — failed silently with relative path before the fix was found.
Staging DB was never reset after Phase 20 schema changes, causing vault init 500 errors that blocked journey timing tests — required diagnosing via SSH/docker logs before root cause was clear.
GSD phase complete tool returned next_phase: 23 even though phase 23 was already marked [x] complete in ROADMAP.md — caused misleading Next Up output.
Context limit hit mid-session requiring user to prompt to continue.
OAuth token expired mid-session requiring re-authentication.
Background task output files for killed/stale tasks were surfaced as notifications requiring reads even when the phase was already complete.
open_items: Journey timing baselines were populated from staging but two human verification items remain: (1) run journey tests against live services to verify sub-journey phase breakdowns, (2) confirm Performance API marks appear in browser DevTools.
Phases 21 and 23 are still actively in progress — phase execution ordering was non-sequential this session.
The GitHub Actions approval requirement for lint-pr-title needs investigation — possible git author email mismatch or GitHub platform policy change.
PERF_ENABLED / __CIPHERBOX_PERF__ integration into the web app entrypoint (to enable perf in browser dev environments) was explicitly deferred as out of scope for this PR.
thresholds.ts silent-skip behavior on missing metrics was flagged by Copilot but kept as intentional — worth revisiting if load tests produce confusing false-passes in the future.
